title: REQUIRED ACCESSORY OFF-STREET PARKING SPACES FOR RESIDENCES
previewText: In the districts indicated, accessory off-street parking spaces shall be required for residences in accordance with the provisions of this Section, inclusive. Separate requirements are set forth for zoning lots in the Inner Transit Zone pursuant to Section 25-21, inclusive, the Outer Transit Zone, pursuant to Section 25-22, inclusive, and beyond the Greater Transit Zone, pursuant to Section 25-23, inclusive.
